items.title: Candlestick Words Improve Intraday Volatility Forecasts Beyond HAR and GARCH
items.claim: Candlestick-word features improve 15-minute volatility forecasts beyond HAR and GARCH after volatility spikes, but add nothing at daily frequency.

items.title: From SEC Filings to Financial Signals: Evaluating LLMs on Stock Market Reactions and Analyst Forecasts
items.claim: Adding cross-sectional fundamental ranks to 10-Q MD&A text raises LLM return-ranking RankIC by about 0.009, while analyst-summary context adds no comparable gain.

items.title: Unbounded Losses, Unchecked Inputs: Measuring the Safeguards of LLM Options-Trading Agents
items.claim: Options-trading agents need loss limits enforced at the order boundary, since 13 of 26 surveyed systems can reach unbounded loss.

items.title: More Mentions, Less Information? Diagnosing Identity and Alignment in Reddit Embeddings for Volatility Forecasting
items.claim: Most of WSB embeddings' standalone volatility fit reflects firm identity, and their gain over HAR is largely eliminated by alignment shuffling.

items.title: Reliable Before Profitable: QuantHarness for Governing Financial Strategy Development with LLM Agents
items.claim: QuantHarness reaches 90.72% task success on FinRelBench versus 74.23–84.54% for comparison systems, under the evaluated protocol.

items.title: Beyond Behavioral Accuracy: Evaluating Individual-Level Fidelity in LLM Investor Simulation
items.claim: No evaluated LLM reliably beats a recent-activity persistence baseline for trade occurrence, and buy-sell structure stays hard to reproduce.
